claim_or_conclusion: It is not possible to determine exactly what happened during the eighteen-minute telemetry gap or identify a single initiating event from the available evidence. The only supported observations are that latency was normal before the gap and the database was saturated afterward. Any detailed timeline or proposed initiating event would be speculation.
evidence_basis: All telemetry was unavailable during the eighteen-minute interval.
Latency was reported as normal before the interval.
The database was reported as saturated after the interval.
No logs, traces, metrics, independent observations, or recovered historical records cover the missing interval.
reasoning_summary: The evidence establishes only the states immediately before and after an unobserved interval. Those endpoints do not uniquely determine the intervening timeline or a single cause, so an exact account cannot be supported.
uncertainties: The sequence of events within the missing interval is unknown.
The cause and timing of database saturation are unknown.
Whether there was one initiating event or multiple contributing events is unknown.
No candidate initiating event can be distinguished from alternatives.
